name: I Can't Believe These Ponies Are So Terrible!
source:
Buff McManly was a man living life on the edge, hosting auditions for a cause even he didn't understand and insulting everyone that appeared before him. He thought his quest had come to a close. He thought he would be able to retire and live a relatively normal life.

He was wrong.

Join Buff McManly as he embarks on another adventure! This time, the stakes are higher than he ever could have imagined, and with his back against the wall, he's going to need a tongue of silver to find his way back home.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=30&t=15808]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
巴夫．麥克曼利曾經是一個把生活過得驚險刺激的男人。他主持著自己甚至無法理解目的的試鏡，還侮辱每一個出現在面前的人。

他以為自己的任務已經結束，以為自己可以退休，過上相對正常的生活。

他錯了。

和巴夫．麥克曼利一起踏上新的冒險吧！這一次，賭注高得超出他的想像。被逼入絕境的他，需要憑藉三寸不爛之舌找到回家的路。

［來自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=30&t=15808]Lemma Soft論壇[/url]］
